title: Puppet Master Product Onboarding contracts
description: Closed Product Onboarding setup-plan, session, continuation, typed UI action, owner-projection, and predecessor-migration contracts for the current nine-stage journey, plus the distinct Bootstrap restore-existing-data preflow handoff and the Remote Access connector projection consumed by Onboarding. The standalone setup plan is a secret-free draft of user choices; session, continuation, and owner-projection records reference its revision and approved SHA-256 instead of embedding it. The Bootstrap preflow is outside the Product Onboarding stage graph.

onboarding_forge_instance_profile.title: OnboardingForgeInstanceProfile
onboarding_forge_instance_profile.description: Secret-free planned Forgejo or Gitea instance inputs plus cached Forge-owner references. Product Onboarding does not probe, authenticate, trust, or activate the instance while writing this draft.
x-puppet-master-assertions: all version, API, Git-transport, Actions, permission, automation-binding, credential, and currentness references resolve through Forge-owned contracts after Review confirmation and never expose secret bytes
automation_binding_ref may resolve to a different provider, instance, account, or host from the repository binding and cannot be inferred from the repository remote
private_ca_ref is instance-scoped and never a certificate path or global TLS-disable instruction; known_host_proof_ref is owner-verified evidence rather than a hostname
Product Onboarding records this draft without a network probe, sign-in, repository operation, trust decision, credential use, or filesystem mutation

onboarding_setup_plan.title: OnboardingSetupPlan
onboarding_setup_plan.description: One closed, planned-only, secret-free Product Onboarding draft. It records user choices and stable non-secret owner references, never live discovery/authentication/trust status or raw pairing, enrollment, credential, or authentication material.

server_trust_confirmed.description: Compatibility projection only. It never requires or represents a visible recognition checkbox and never substitutes for Server-owner pairing and trust results.

x-puppet-master-assertions: project_transport and backup_transport describe how an existing folder or backup is reached; storage_transport independently describes the chosen network storage protocol
history_backend=git|jujutsu is a local Safe History choice independent from online_mode and forge; Git and Jujutsu never require an account
an online copy binds both forge_account_ref and repository_ref; already_connected means reuse that explicit account and repository binding and is never a no-op

connect_existing chooses a route first, then the owner discovers or accepts the selected server_ref and performs connection_pairing=approval|code|qr; server_trust_confirmed is compatibility state only and never creates a visible recognition-checkbox gate
local_or_vpn uses LAN discovery and optionally scans already-enabled VPN interfaces when include_vpn_networks=true; it never requires a private endpoint or configures a VPN
hosted Tailscale checks current owner state before at most one protected sign-in; live signed-in and peer-discovery status remains an owner projection rather than a durable setup choice
Headscale consumes headscale_url before owner-managed enrollment and subsequent Server discovery; it never uses hosted-Tailscale account sign-in

connect_existing reverse_proxy consumes only the existing HTTPS proxy_hostname plus Server pairing; null proxy_kind, proxy_hosting, and proxy_tls prove that it does not configure Caddy, NGINX, Traefik, certificates, or another proxy
remote_endpoint is a non-secret manual discovery fallback or Puppet Master Remote Link reference; it never contains raw pairing, enrollment, credential, or authentication material

repository_visibility=internal requires a current provider capability projection before dispatch; GitLab hosted means GitLab.com and rejects internal, self_managed GitLab remains capability-probed, Azure DevOps visibility belongs to its project and stays null, and Cursor Origin Preview permits only private or internal

Forgejo and Gitea each require a matching distinct onboarding_forge_instance_profile; forge_instance_url equals that profile's web_base_url and the profile's cached refs cannot be treated as live/current owner proof

before person confirmation of the exact reviewed queued plan revision, forge/account/repository/automation choices cause no owner dispatch, network probe, authentication, trust decision, credential use, repository operation, or filesystem mutation

after confirmation, account connection/authentication, Forge repository list/create/bind, backend-native clone/publish, optional AutomationBinding setup, and Project registration dispatch only through their canonical owners with currentness, permission, FileSafe, idempotency, ObservableWork, and typed terminal returns
AutomationBinding is independent from RepositoryForgeBinding and may name a different provider, instance, account, or host; absence of automation_binding_ref never disables ordinary Git or Jujutsu

simple_path_selection.description: Current setup-origin selection made on the canonical simple_path stage and preserved across continuation, owner projection, and migration.

x-puppet-master-assertions: person_confirmed_reviewed_plan requires reviewed_setup_plan_revision == queued_setup_plan_revision; consumers must reject a mismatch because standard JSON Schema cannot express equality between sibling instance values
approved_setup_plan_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the exact reviewed queued plan revision and is never a hash of display copy, mutable owner state, credentials, secrets, or protected browser content
automatic_preparation_currentness_ref resolves to currentness evidence fenced by the same queued/reviewed revision and approved SHA-256

onboarding_action_result.title: OnboardingActionResult
onboarding_action_result.description: Closed result/error envelope for a typed Product Onboarding local action. Local choreography never claims domain-owner mutation or a production receipt.
x-puppet-master-assertions: ui.onboarding.open_details preserves stage_before == stage_after and exposes at most one bounded stage disclosure or one bounded choice explanation
choice explanations use intent=toggle_choice_explanation with the exact current stage as scope and a stable help-topic selection_ref; they are ephemeral, owner-route-free, and non-persistent
ui.onboarding.open_details is ephemeral and never writes OnboardingSession or owner state
every persisted action result continuation_snapshot.stage equals stage_after and the durable history ends at that same current stage

the exact canonical main-path stage order is welcome -> simple_path -> first_project -> source_control_setup -> server_storage_client -> remote_access_setup -> review_setup_plan -> automatic_preparation -> ready

connect_existing_server uses the exact shortcut welcome -> simple_path -> remote_access_setup -> review_setup_plan -> automatic_preparation -> ready and does not materialize skipped first_project, source_control_setup, or server_storage_client history entries

a current session or continuation at first_project or any later stage has a non-null simple_path_selection; null is current only before a choice at welcome or simple_path, while later-stage predecessor null input is handled only by the migration receipt boundary

continuation history is the exact ordered prefix of either the nine-stage main path or the six-stage connect_existing_server path selected by simple_path_selection; cross-path and skipped-stage histories are rejected
path_kind is null before a path choice, equals connect_existing only for connect_existing_server, and equals guided_setup only for the three normal choices

queued_setup_plan_ref and queued_setup_plan_revision are a paired durable reference and revision; person confirmation binds reviewed_setup_plan_revision to that exact queued revision and approved_setup_plan_sha256 to the exact reviewed bytes without embedding the plan

automatic_preparation and ready require a person-confirmed reviewed plan plus a non-null automatic_preparation_currentness_ref; unconfirmed state carries null reviewed revision, approved hash, and currentness reference

ui.onboarding.start advances welcome -> simple_path; ui.onboarding.choose_simple_path advances simple_path -> first_project except that connect_existing_server advances simple_path -> remote_access_setup
ui.onboarding.back returns to the exact preceding entry in durable history, so remote_access_setup returns to simple_path on connect_existing_server and to server_storage_client on the main path

ui.onboarding.open_owner_flow is unavailable before review_setup_plan, requires person_confirmed_reviewed_plan at review_setup_plan, and is allowed at automatic_preparation only as a previously_confirmed_reviewed_plan resume or owner return with an existing owner_operation_ref
server_setup is predecessor seven-stage lineage only and is rejected by every current stage, scope, session, continuation, return-context, request, and result field
one user choice dispatches at most one owner route; a current terminal owner return advances without an additional confirmation action
scm_backend_selection and forge_provider_selection are independent; Jujutsu is never represented as a forge or account and none means local-only
cmd.source_control.repository.init is forbidden; a new local Project uses cmd.project.new_local with init_git=true through the Project owner
ui.onboarding.defer persists the exact current stage, branch, revision, continuation, and return focus before the modal closes
ui.onboarding.defer never sets completed, skipped, ready, or any owner-readiness state

automatic_preparation_owner_projection.title: AutomaticPreparationOwnerProjection
automatic_preparation_owner_projection.description: One closed Product Onboarding projection over owner-owned ObservableWork, result, receipt, and exact currentness. Product Onboarding observes this record; it does not implement, time, cancel, duplicate, or infer the underlying work. Browser concept fixtures are explicitly non-production and cannot carry a production receipt or readiness claim.
x-puppet-master-assertions: completed_units <= total_units for determinate progress

the accepting adapter compares session, current simple-path selection, exact reviewed_setup_plan_revision, exact approved_setup_plan_sha256, local backend, optional forge, target, expected revision, continuation generation, and exact next projection generation to its active fence rather than trusting currentness booleans
stale or mismatched projections are rejected without replacing the last accepted projection or advancing the stage
close, defer, resume, reload, and view changes preserve owner work and reuse the same owner_operation_id and dedupe_key
automatic preparation advances only after an accepted current ready projection; timers may settle presentation after readiness but never synthesize work, progress, result, receipt, or readiness
a browser concept fixture never claims production owner work, production readiness, native runtime execution, or a production receipt

bootstrap_restore_existing_pm_data_prefl.title: BootstrapRestoreExistingPmDataPreflow
bootstrap_restore_existing_pm_data_prefl.description: Closed Bootstrap-owned handoff for Restore Existing PM Data after safe local claim and before Product Onboarding. This is not a Product Onboarding stage, simple-path choice, or replacement for the Product Onboarding Project-level Restore a backup choice.
x-puppet-master-assertions: this record is owned by safe Bootstrap and is never inserted into the canonical Product Onboarding stage enum, history, or progress denominator

the preflow can import or connect a destination, unlock, discover, browse, and preview only through Backup Restore owner contracts; it does not require an old Server Catalog or model-provider authentication
no external effect or mutation begins before a person confirms the current final preview and its exact hash
Project-level Restore a backup remains the Product Onboarding choice and is not widened into Full Server recovery
raw Recovery Key or Kit bytes, destination credentials, authentication URLs or codes, browser content, connector state, and tsnet node keys are never persisted in this record
foreign or new Server recovery creates a new connector identity and re-pairs; same-host takeover requires the separately fenced Backup and Remote Access owner path
event_family_ids remains empty until Event Authority admits exact families; owner receipts and projections do not imply an EventRecord

onboarding_connector_owner_projection.title: OnboardingConnectorOwnerProjection
onboarding_connector_owner_projection.description: Secret-free Product Onboarding consumer projection of the Remote Access owner connector. It preserves the PM-owned Go tsnet connector phase, durable authorization handoff, Server identity, PM pairing/trust, private endpoint, browser reachability, and static-evidence boundaries without making Onboarding the connector or trust owner.
x-puppet-master-assertions: the connector phase is Remote Access owner truth; Product Onboarding only observes it and never owns process, IPC, authorization, endpoint, Funnel, identity, pairing, or trust transitions
connector identity is infrastructure bound one-per-server_id and never substitutes for verified PM Server identity, pairing, or trust
tailnet membership, route reachability, connector readiness, a device label, or a visible recognition checkbox never implies PM identity verification, pairing, or trust

cached_pre_review may describe already-existing owner state but cannot start login, enrollment, endpoint testing, identity acceptance, pairing, trust, network configuration, or any other external effect
automatic_preparation begins only after current Review confirmation through the separately fenced Product Onboarding owner projection
authorization work survives refresh and Client loss by owner operation identity, but protected URL or browser content is never embedded and requires a new current authorized handoff on another Client
ordinary browsers are not enrolled by embedded tsnet and still require host-private reachability or an explicit public/reverse-proxy/Remote-Link route
Headscale supports private access but never Funnel
browser concept fixtures remain simulated and cannot claim production work, readiness, native execution, security proof, or connector runtime
event_family_ids remains empty until Event Authority admits exact connector families; owner receipts and projections remain non-event evidence

onboarding_legacy_migration_receipt.title: OnboardingLegacyMigrationReceipt
onboarding_legacy_migration_receipt.description: Domain reconciliation receipt for a one-time legacy provider-first/four-screen, predecessor five-stage, or predecessor seven-stage mapping into the current nine-stage journey. Predecessor stage tokens are source-lineage values only and are never accepted by current stage fields. The referenced pm.storage_value.migration_receipt.v1 remains the sole terminal durable storage migration receipt. The x-puppet-master-assertions rules are mandatory; a consumer that cannot enforce them must reject the receipt.
x-puppet-master-assertions: source_record_count == accepted_record_count + stale_record_count + dropped_record_count + quarantined_record_count
sum(mapped_stage_counts.*) == accepted_record_count + stale_record_count
mapped_path_counts.guided_setup + mapped_path_counts.connect_existing == accepted_record_count + stale_record_count

every migrated unresolved draft is unconfirmed and carries null reviewed_setup_plan_revision, approved_setup_plan_sha256, and automatic_preparation_currentness_ref; migration never fabricates review or currentness
terminal_status == 'committed' implies quarantined_record_count == 0
each accepted or stale legacy row maps once to the first applicable unresolved canonical stage
predecessor server_setup maps only to current server_storage_client and never becomes a current stage token
predecessor seven-stage rows preserve their source machine and disposition lineage while newly required simple_path and review_setup_plan resolution follows the disposition manifest
no installation, authentication, restore, Project, provider, Server, or source-control owner work is rerun
